# mdzgholi.ge — Driver On Call & Car Services in Tbilisi, Georgia

> mdzgholi.ge is Georgia's leading 24/7 on-demand driver and roadside assistance service, based in Tbilisi.

- **Name:** mdzgholi.ge
- **Website:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge
- **Phone & WhatsApp:** +995 568 83 47 07
- **Email:** info@mdzgholi.ge

## Services

### 1. Sober Driver (ფხიზელი მძღოლი / მძღოლი გამოძახებით)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/sober-driver

A professional, sober driver meets you at your location (restaurant, bar, party, clinic, event) and drives you home safely **in your own car**. Your vehicle stays with you — no need to retrieve it the next day.

- **Starting price:** from 40 GEL within Tbilisi (agreed upfront)
- **Availability:** 24/7, 365 days/year
- **Arrival time:** 15–20 minutes on average
- **Book via:** phone call or WhatsApp to +995 568 83 47 07

**Common use cases:** after drinking alcohol at a restaurant or party, fatigue/exhaustion after a long day, post-medical procedures, car relocation/transfers.

**Q: How do I book a sober driver in Tbilisi?**
A: Call or WhatsApp +995 568 83 47 07. The operator will respond immediately and dispatch the nearest available driver. No advance booking required, though recommended on holidays.

**Q: Does the sober driver use my own car?**
A: Yes. The driver arrives at your location and drives you home in your own vehicle. The driver then returns via a support vehicle.

**Q: How much does a sober driver cost in Tbilisi?**
A: Prices start from 40 GEL within Tbilisi. The exact fare is agreed upfront with the dispatcher based on route and distance.

**Q: Is the sober driver service available at 4 AM or on public holidays?**
A: Yes. mdzgholi.ge operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year — including New Year's Eve, Easter, and all public holidays.

**Q: What if there's an accident while the sober driver is driving my car?**
A: All mdzgholi.ge drivers are vetted professionals. In the unlikely event of an incident, the company takes full responsibility per its protocols.

**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/personal-driver

A dedicated professional driver for daily, weekly, or monthly hire — full-time or part-time. Ideal for business executives, families, and individuals who need consistent, reliable transportation in Tbilisi.

- **Options:** full-time, part-time, daily, weekly, or monthly contracts
- **Vehicle:** driver operates your own vehicle
- **Languages:** drivers available in Georgian, English, and Russian

**Q: Can I hire a personal driver on a daily basis in Tbilisi?**
A: Yes. mdzgholi.ge offers single-day, daily, weekly, and monthly packages tailored to your schedule.

**Q: Can the personal driver transport my children to school?**
A: Yes. All drivers undergo rigorous background checks and are highly responsible. Many clients trust mdzgholi.ge for family transportation.

**Q: Do the personal drivers speak English or Russian?**
A: Yes. mdzgholi.ge has drivers fluent in English and Russian, making them ideal for international clients and business partners.

**Q: Can mdzgholi.ge tow an SUV or minivan?**

### 4. Car Wash with Pickup & Delivery (მანქანის რეცხვა)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/car-wash

mdzgholi.ge picks up your car from your home or office, takes it to a professional car wash facility, and delivers it back — fully clean. No waiting in lines.

- **Service:** pickup, full interior & exterior premium wash, delivery back to you
- **Packages:** exterior only, interior only, or full comprehensive wash
- **Duration:** 1.5 to 3 hours on average

**Q: How does the car wash pickup service work in Tbilisi?**
A: You call mdzgholi.ge, a driver comes to your address, picks up your car, takes it to a partner wash facility, and returns it fully clean. A handover document is prepared for your safety.

**Q: What if something is damaged during the car wash?**
A: mdzgholi.ge takes full responsibility for any damage during the service. Compensation is provided per agreement.

### 5. Airport Transfer & Intercity (აეროპორტის ტრანსფერი)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/airport-transfer

Punctual airport transfers to/from Tbilisi International Airport, Kutaisi, and Batumi airports. Also covers intercity routes across all of Georgia — Batumi, Kutaisi, Kazbegi, and more.

- **Meet & greet:** driver meets you in the arrival hall with a name sign
- **Flight monitoring:** driver adjusts arrival time based on real flight data; waiting for delays is free
- **Vehicles:** sedans (3–4 passengers) and minivans (6–8 passengers)
- **Pricing:** fixed rates, agreed in advance, including parking fees

**Q: How does the airport pickup work with mdzgholi.ge?**
A: The driver meets you in the arrivals hall with a sign displaying your name. Flight tracking ensures the driver is there at your actual landing time — delays don't cost you extra.

**Q: Can mdzgholi.ge do a transfer from Tbilisi to Batumi?**
A: Yes. mdzgholi.ge covers intercity routes across all of Georgia, including Tbilisi–Batumi, Tbilisi–Kutaisi, and Tbilisi–Kazbegi.

**Q: Can I request a child seat for an airport transfer?**
A: Yes. Specify this during booking and a child safety seat will be provided.

### 6. Battery Jump Start & Tire Change (აკუმულატორი / საბურავი)
**URL:** https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/battery-tire

On-site roadside assistance in Tbilisi: battery jump start, battery replacement, and tire repair or change — no tow truck needed.

- **Arrival time:** 15–20 minutes on average
- **Services:** jump start, battery diagnostics, battery replacement, tire repair (plug), tire change with spare
- **Vehicle types:** all passenger cars, SUVs, and minivans

**Q: Can mdzgholi.ge replace a car battery on-site in Tbilisi?**
A: Yes. If a jump start doesn't work, a specialist can bring and install a new battery at your location.

**Q: What if I have a flat tire but no spare?**
A: The specialists can repair the tire on-site using a plug, allowing you to continue your journey safely.

**Q: Is the battery/tire service available at night in Tbilisi?**
A: Yes. mdzgholi.ge's technical team is on duty 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## About mdzgholi.ge

mdzgholi.ge was established to provide safe, reliable, and convenient driver and roadside services to residents and visitors of Georgia. The company prioritizes:

- **Safety:** all drivers are vetted, experienced professionals
- **Speed:** average response time of 15–20 minutes
- **Transparency:** all prices are agreed upfront — no hidden fees
- **Availability:** 24/7, every day of the year
- **Trust:** your car and personal safety are treated with the highest care
